data.body:
[P2] Apply reconstructed outcomes before making completion decisions

A cached `ReplayChildren` item can report `SUCCEEDED` and subsequently reject during reconstruction—the new unit test explicitly covers that divergence. With `maxConcurrency: 1` and default fail-fast behavior, this branch leaves `failureCount` at zero and starts the next item; if that item awaits a callback, the batch suspends instead of returning the observed failure. With `minSuccessful: 1`, the provisional success already closes the gate, and resolution instead returns `ALL_COMPLETED` with zero successes and remaining items never started. Recomputing counts only in `resolveBatch` is too late. Use finalized reconstruction outcomes before scheduling or irreversibly closing the gate, and add regressions for both configurations.
